heading: Tonight
text: Scattered evening showers or thunderstorms, diminishing overnight. Mixed clouds with a chance of patchy valley fog. Warm and very muggy. Lows in the 60s to near 70. Wind diminishing to light and variable.

heading: Friday
text: A mix of sun and clouds. Chance of a few widely scattered showers or a thunderstorm, increasing chances in the afternoon. Warm and humid. Highs in the 80s to near 90. Light south wind.

heading: Friday Night
text: Scattered evening showers with a chance of embedded thunderstorms, diminishing overnight. Some patches of valley fog. Mild and muggy. Lows in the 60s to near 70. Calm wind.
